nom: Exuviance Pick-Me-Up Plumping Mask with Hyaluronic Acid

avis.texte: So easy to put on and it does not slide. My skin and appearance look great

Theres no other face mask like this especially once that IS NOT regular Sheet mask. This sticks on really well! My skin is plump, hydrated, smooth, and it helped with my redness irritations. Would order 100 of these if i could.
I feel like face masks are always uncomfortable and fall off, not this one! It always leaves my face super smooth and silky. Love this for travel days!

This is hands down the best sheet mask I have ever used! Whenever I have a big event I throw on one of these sheet masks because I know it just gives my skin an amazing glow. 10/10 always reccomend this to my friends!

In the winter my skin feels dry and dull. I used this mask and it immediately added bounc and hydration! I highly recommend to anyobe especially those with sensitive skin! It is ny new go to! I used this mask and decided to skip the makeup and I received compliments on my glowy skin! I highly recommend this product. For reference i am 41 and have combination sensitive skin.

I really enjoyed this mask! It was very hydrating and left my skin feeling refreshed. I do not know about the plumping effect but my skin felt great afterwards. The way the mask is set up is also interesting.

As I was checking out at Ulta, the sales person asked if I'd like to throw a sheet mask on to my order. I said sure. I had a gala to go to that night so took it home and used it right away. I can't tell you how much I loved what my skin look like after I used it. It was dewy, plump and my skin felt amazing. I gave all the ladies in my family one on Christmas. And i just used another one this morning. I'm down to my last one, so I'm off to Ulta for more tomorrow.

One of the best masks on the market (although a little pricey for single use). I leave it on longer than 15 minutes when I have the extra time. Easy to apply, stays in place, as well as refreshes and brightens my skin! I have purchased multiple times and will continue to.

avis.titre: Sensitive skin but my skin loved!
avis.texte: I hope this helps anyone who is sensitive with reactive skin that's acne prone. I was hesitant to try it because I finally cleared hormonal acne, but I was going to an event and needed a pick me up. This plumped up my skin, absorbed well with the rest of my regimen. My makeup applied beautifully. I have textured scars on my face and this definitely plumped them. I would highly recommend if you're going to an event. I even put it on backwards initially left it on for 30 minutes to be make sure I got all of the moisture. Hoping they have a sale so I can stock up.

This mask is it. Its luxurious feeling, hydrating, and effective. My skin feels so soft after and it's the perfect balance of a product that isnt thick or super watery. I can't really describe how great it is, at a loss for words. Just buy it. Or 10.
The best mask ever! 15 minutes and my 11s are gone, eyes are refreshed, skin is plump — no burning like some masks. I have to stop myself from touching my face—it still feels amazing two days later.

You have to peel the mesh off both sides!!! Come on guys, read the directions. This mask is SOOO hydrating and plumping and leaves your skin so glowy and smooth!! There's no other sheet mask like it!! 🩵
I had high hopes but this mask didn't do much at all. i find cheaper masks do a better job

I felt like my skin needed a pick-me-up, and I had a self-care night. First, the way the mask is packaged is nice and luxe. There are two mesh protective layers on either side of it that you peel off prior to applying. It adhered nicely to my skin and covered the edges of my face, which sometimes can be an issue with sheet masks. I left the mask on a little longer than the instructions stated (probably around 25 minutes) and massaged the rest of the serum into my skin. This time of year, it doesn't matter how much I hydrate my skin at nighttime, I'll wake up with some flakes. I was worried about that using this mask because it was essentially the only skincare I did that night. I woke up with fewer dry patches than normal and my skin was glowy. It felt very hydrated and supple. I have hormonal acne and combo skin, this didn't irritate me at all. Highly recommend, especially at this price point!
The mask is hydrating. My skin feels soft and supple. To the person saying the 'mesh is dry and didn't stick to your face' - you're supposed to REMOVE the mesh. Please read the directions.

There are much better masks out there that are cheaper. This one feels almost dry, doesn't stick to face and is to big. Material is a little thicker that other masks. I ended up making slits to have it lie flat. Feel like it did nothing.

I would not recommend this product. It almost felt dry and the mesh material does not stick onto your face. I was very disappointed. The only way I could get this to stay on is if I laid on my back, I ended up throwing it away.

I really like this product I have sensitive skin and it didn't bother me at all. There is a slight scent but nothing awful or unpleasant also the ingredients weren't harsh for my skin. The packaging was really nice and super cute as well.

This product was nice, especially using it after the peel-masks. My skin was plumped and hydrated. Super happy with the results, although it is pretty expensive. Might skip this product and use a different, less-expensive one in the future.
Really nice mask thicker than a lot of them I've tried. It is really cooling and smells nice. Wonderful feeling on the skin I am a fan of it for sure and would use again
Very moisturizing and hydrating face mask. No weird fragrance and my skin didn't feel irritated after use. Skin feels soft and supple, will recommend

This mask helped my tired, dry skin look amazing again! I liked the fact it had the mesh on it even if it was a little difficult to pull apart on the first layer. My skin felt a little sticky after but looked great.
The ingredients in this product seem to pair nicely after doing a peel. It is plumping and leaves the skin feeling smooth. For a face mask though I do feel like it's overpriced

This mask gave my skin a much needed dose of hydration. This cooling and calming feeling on the face was relaxing for me. I really loved how lightweight and non greasy the mask seurm was compared to other masks I've tried. This also wasn't DRIPPING in the mask serum, which I appreciated a lot. It felt like my skin absorbed it pretty quickly after I took this off because Ididn'tt have much product to rub into my face. My my face was moisturized and soft and plump. I really would like more of these masks.

The mask was SUPER hydrating and I loved that it was so silky and fresh. My skin 100% looked hydrated after and I would definitely purchase a set to use maybe 2x per week, especially during the summer! The scent was soft in my opinion and the packaging was just as simple to use as almost any other food and peel mask. I loved that it included caffeine and I was impressed by how refreshed I actually looked. Love.

This plumping mask is so easy to use! Mess free with easy to follow instructions. I have combination, sensitive skin that is acne and eczema prone. I found that this plumping mask not only makes your skin feel more firm and plump, but it also provides a ton of hydration and moisture. I felt that my complexion appeared more radiant and hydrated after using this mask.
This mask was so simple to use and had my skin looks so soft and supple afterwards. I like that it doesn't have a strong scent and wasn't harsh on my skin.
I received this product from influenster for my review. I love sheet masks and this one from exuviance left my skin looking hydrated and glowing. I would repurchase this item!

Exceptional facial mask! It did exactly what it said. Plumping firming moisture it had it all! Proof is in my photo left is before right is after the mask applied for 15 minutes. I definitely would recommend to a friend.

My skin feels so hydrated and plump after just using this mask one time. My face is so soft and is also smoother. I like how easy it is to apply and how well it stays on my face I leave it on 15 minutes and then i take it of and run in whats leftover! So easy . I highly recommend this mask to everyone !

Left my skin soft and smooth ! Only tried one but I saw a slight difference in my skin . Left my skin looking radiant and a slight more fresh . It had no scent and I am sensitive skinned and had no reaction I thought it was great .
I love this mask. The packaging was perfect because it was mess free. I like the mask and it was easy to apply. The directions were very clear. I like this system overall
This is a really nice super plumping mask, perfect if you have very dry skin as it boosts hydration. Great value and ingredients. Plus the packaging is cute.

Masks are great, this was a nice addition to the peel kit. It seem to nourish my skin nicely. But having an overall plumping effect, I don't necessarily see. Otherwise it wasn't irritating to my skin and left it smooth.
I liked the texture of this product and appreciated how it left my skin feeling hydrated after application. I typically have dry skin, so I could see myself using this on the future, as well!
I love this mask! This was super cooling and I felt like my skin was different after using it. It did in fact feel more plump. Minimal scent with this one. Packaging is like every other mask
I liked this better than the two step mask product. But I would not say this would be something I purchase again there's better brands. Also not cruelty free so I would not use again.
This made my skin feel really nice! I wish the effects lasted longer. My face felt more plump after using it, but it didn't last for more than a couple of hours. The smell wasn't bad either.
The amazing mass very effective. Love the ingredients in it and the texture that provides my skin. Packaging is very well too. ￼ I highly recommend this for any skin care routine.

The effectiveness of this product works well I really enjoyed the scent of the product. The packaging of this product is great and there are no bad ingredients in it. I love the texture of this product and how it feels. If you are looking for a product to help improve your skin tone this would be for you.
This sheet mask is the perfect aftercare for an at home chemical peel. It is very hydrating and super easy to use. I definitely felt like it plumped my skin and made it look brighter.
Great product. The packaging made it easy to use. I like that it felt nice on my skin and the scent was not overbearing. I think it works great and I would buy again
Left skin feeling intensely hydrated, looking smoother, softer and improved overall appearance of skin. Just wish I had more than just one single use mask.
This mask is so hydrating and it makes my skin feel so soft and supple. The glow I get after using this is amazing. The scent is light and not overwhelming either.
It has really good scent. Package is so slick. I can't say about the ingredients as I didn't look at it. But it feels so good on skin after the use. It felt good.
This mask was so refreshing and plumping on my skin. It was so easy to use at home and made me feel like I was at a spa. The sent is amazing and the packaging is so sleek. ￼

I think I liked this one better. The ingredients were great, the scent was lowkey and it made my skin soft and dewy. Like the other one, the packaging needs major help. Dull and boring and I wouldn't look at it in a store.

First time using this product I really like this mask! This is one of the best masks I've ever used - it fit my face, no tingling or burning feeling. Super smooth texture when you apply it. Super refreshing and no allergic reaction.

avis.titre: Will leave you glowing and hydrated.
avis.texte: I received this mask complimentary from Influenster and Exuviance in exchange for my honest review. Im a big fan of sheet masks and this one did not dissapoint. Very hydrating and I liked the fact that it was nice and soaked in the serum. The shape of the mask went on my face easily. My skin also didn't have a negative reaction to this one so that was a plus. After use, it left my skin plumper and glowing beautifully.
After using this mask in my face it haves natural effective ingredients and good texture and nice smelling scent and good packaging appearance .
I love this product a lot! I would definitely love to try it again. It made my skin feel very nice and the packaging was very modern. I would say it's worth a try

Whenever my skin needs an extra boost of moisture I reach for this facial mask. I put on the mask as directed. After the mask sits and dry up I use the remainder liquid from the packaging onto my face. I have notice a more hydrated and firm skin. This is perfect to use after a chemical peel.

I received this product complimentary in exchange for an honest review. I absolutely loved this mask. You can tell it is made from quality products, it made my skin feel very smooth. I also loved the packaging, it looks luxurious.

avis.titre: We will see how it turns out
avis.texte: I always love a really good clumping mask. The smell of this is actually pretty nice and I feel like once my face is not broken out this will really help bring the lightness back to it. ￼

Easy to use in the single use packaging for a face mask. Was not over saturated with the mask gel that it was dripping off my face like I've had with other masks like this. My skin felt very hydrated and smooth after using this. There was a little left on my face when I removed it and I just massaged it in. I like that there is no scent as I don't like scented skincare masks since it's right on your nose. Overall I thought it was a good mask and was happy to try this as a free sample.

I had high expectations for this mask since I love the exuberance peel pads so much. It's a fine mask, but I didn't see or feel a huge difference between it and many other masks I've used. The material is strong so it's easy to unfold. That being said it doesn't form to your face as well as a thinner mask would.

Exuviance facial mask smells great feels super cool on ur face and is large enough for any size . Love that it contains Hyaluronic acid and caffeine which not only plumps ur skin but also instant hydration for dry skin. I have combination skin so this is great it is suitable for sensitive skin. Upon first use I noticed smooth softer skin and liked the glow my skin shows after using. I love facial masks this is a good one . Easy to use and after removal just massage rest in .

I definitely need more of these masks. Wish it would've come with more than one mask because I loved it. Gave me a nice glow and made my skin feel soft and silky. Doesn't have a crazy smell like other masks I've tried which is great. Doesn't burn my skin either has very mild ingredients.

Biocellulose masks are my go-to for a reason. They hug my face perfectly, boosting the absorption of all those good-for-you ingredients. The first try can be a bit tricky, so follow the instructions closely. But once it's on, it works wonders. My skin feels incredibly hydrated and supple after using it, especially following their at-home facial peel. It's the ultimate glow-up recipe for a radiant and refreshed complexion.
this is my favorite mask it leaves my skin very plump like it's very hydrating. I love the way the mask feels it smells really good to smell like you're in a spa. Overall I recommend.

I was very pleasantly surprised by this. It was the most comfortable face mask I've ever done and left my skin super soft. Even the next morning my face is still feeling more hydrated and soft. I would absolutely purchase again as a hydration booster for when my skin is feeling extra dry.

Loved the mask, it was very plumping and refreshing and gave me a bit of hydration that I need, with this heat coming I'll definitely need all the hydration as my face can get drying and don't want to get sunburned..thank you Influenster
This felt very nice and hydrating on my skin! I didn't any reactions to this. This was very cool and refreshing for me. This made my skin feel very plump and smooth. I loved this

Self care at its finest! Who doesn't love to take 15 minutes for themselves to take a bath and wear a facial and feel rejuvenated? This mask does just that! It's a quick self care item that you can use at home that leaves your skin soft and glowing. I love the smell and simple ingredients. I have very sensitive skin and had no issues. I received this item complimentary for my honest review.

This made my skin feel hydrated, moisturized and super plump. I used it before I put on make up and it was the absolute perfect skin prep. I have sensitive skin and this did not bother my skin at all.
Mask clings to face and is left on for 15 minutes. After that just rub the excess into the face. My fave really feels more plump!!! Had hyaluronic acid for moisture.

I was excited to try this mask! It was very easy to use - both to put o and take off. I found it very hydrating to my skin and I didn't have any negative reactions or redness. It felt really refreshing and cool on my skin. My skin felt amazing! The hyaluronic acid was great for my skin and I would use this again!
I love a good mask and this mask is definitely my new favorite. It's a little pick me up kind of mask with a good plump for the skin. My face felt so smooth and nice. I really loved this product!!

This is the bougie thing I've ever tried I think, and I'm glad I got to because it is amazing. This sheet mask is a lot different than any other sheet mask I've tried they use a liner to protect the mask itself on both sides most cheap mask you ripped the plastic open and you guys just peeled apart and they're ready to go this way you put it on the one side you put it on your face and then you pee the other side so it's really locked and it's clean. it's great and I will say it felt really nice tight firming it really plump my skin, it just feels really like luxurious ￼
This was a little too strong for my skin. My skin was slightly irritated so I did not continue to use the product. This may work for someone else but not me.
Amazing do at home mask! My skin is much better after suing it. It was my second time using the brand and all the products have best quality!!!!!!!
Love the feel of this mask. Smells good too. My skin looked very dewy and plump honestly. I really like this mask a lot. I would use it again if not make it a staple

I absolutely loved this mask. The peeling treatment left my skin a bit dry because of the acid, but this mask brought back the hydration right away. There is not much to say besides that I really liked it. I'll definitely buy some more to pair with the peeling treatment!!

The Exuviance Pick-Me-Up Plumping Mask was easy to use and very effective. The mask has a mesh layer that you take off before applying the mask. Once it is on your face you then remove the top mesh layer as well. It was a little difficult at first trying to grab ahold of the mesh layers to remove them. However, they are necessary to protect the mask since it is super saturated. I feel like the layers also help the product stay on the mask. With others that I have used in the past, a lot of the serum remains in the package and you have to squeeze it out. After using the mask my skin felt very hydrated and smooth.
Strangest sheet mask material ever. It was a bit too stiff, not fitting well near my chin or mouth because it wasn't flexible enough. The formula was nice, blended in well after removal.

I recieved the Exuviance pick me up plumping mask, and it's a great product! I love that it is unscented, has clean ingredients and left my skin feeling hydrated and plump for sure! It was so refreshing and the extra caffeine in the ingredients definitely helped me not feel so dull.
This pick me up plumping mask worked great on my skin. It contains hyaluronic acid and caffeine leaving the skin loop looking rejuvenated and clean.
This mask is very moisturizing! My skin felt great after I used it. It made it very smooth and soft. It has a pleasant fragrance, but it's very light.

I have to laugh. When I opened the sheet mask I thought they forgot to put it inside and that it was just the mesh. Once I put it up to my face I realized the mask was attached but it's a very different mask than most sheet masks. It still has a bit of that mesh look but without the rough feeling. The mask seems to hold the serum better than traditional ones. Which keeps it on your face better. I really like their sheet masks! Super comfortable, big enough to cover my whole face and the serum actually penetrates the skin, leaving it plump and juicy looking skin that lasts through the day! Highly recommend
I did not feel like it did much of anything for my face. I do have sensitive skin and Maybe felt a tingle or so while using this product. It did make my skin feel softer.
Oh my gosh I wish a had a ton of them my face after using this mask is super hydrated. I have noticed how after the mask my skin looks and feels so much better! I will repurchase!

Scent wasn't bad. The packaging was nice and sleek. Having only tried this mask once I'm not sure I see to much difference but will definitely be repurchasing it so I can get a better understanding of the product. Thank you Influenster for sending it to me complimentary.

This is a beautiful at home mask to have on hand! While it's not miracle worker, it does provide instand plumping. After using and rubbing in excess afterwards, my face was so supple and glowy. There was a noticeable reduction in fine lines around my eyes and brow and returned a more youthful look to my complexion before an event I had to attend! Highly recommend!

This Pick-Me-Up Plumping Mask is a game changer. It is Infused my skin with instant hydration. It contains hyaluronic acid mask with caffeine that provides intense plumping hydration for all skin types, including dehydrated, sensitive skin. I've been struggling with dry skin and this is so perfect to me. I feel like my skin became more nourished and hydrated. It is more smooth, and supple, it doesn't have scent to me, with a texture that easily absorbed.
This mask immediately made my skin so happy! It was so moist and plum and happy for 3 days after!! Not too much of a scent which was really nice, and it was very easy to apply. I would recommend!
This mask makes my skin look so great! It gave me a baby soft finish while brightening my whole face. It's also very soothing and relaxing. Definitely recommend

Does this work….yes, but I feel that there's nothing over the top about this mask vs. my favorite Hydroboost face mask. I gave it 4 stars because the product works as described and that means so much to me as a consumer. However, the price is where a star got knocked off. If you are new to skincare and prefer working with an entire line I would definitely recommend this, but not everyone has the funds to keep this type of regimen up on a consistent basis and the name of the skincare game is consistency.
Thesis mask made my skin feel soft and supple. I enjoyed how it felt and it didn't have a very strong smell. The packaging is easy to open and it is easy to use.
Plumped my skin right up which is needed for dry climate and people prone to dry skin. Helped while doing the peels! I love this mask so much. No weird residue or anything.

First off, I'm going to say that I like the minimalist packaging and brand colors. I really like that it has no fragrance, the mask is made of a textured, resistant material that covers my skin very well, with the necessary amount of product, so it does not drip, nor is it uncomfortable to maneuver. My skin felt very soft and fresh after use.
Really nice single use mask that leaves your face feeling really smooth and hydrated. I like the small pouch that you can easily put in your makeup bag and travel with.

I was sent this Pick-Me-Up Plumping Mask free to review and it's definitely as good as it claims to be. I will say it fits and stays on my face better than any other mask I've ever used. It comes in between these mesh liners that help keep the product on the mask and helps the mask adhere to skin. The mask itself is thick and full of serum. There's no scent. You can move around with this on and actually get other things done while this mask is doing its job. It doesn't slide or slip. After 15 mins I rubbed in the extra and my skin was glowing! It left my face hydrated , full of life, smooth, and plump. It left my combination skin feeling and looking beautiful. The price tag isn't bad for its effectiveness. Definitely worth it for me and I'd recommend!

I love the texture of this mask! It's like a gel consistency. It didnt Leak and it latched onto my face with easy. I let this sit for 15 minutes and then 6 it. My face felt instantly hydrated! It does contain caffeine to wake your skin up and hyaluronic acid to plump it out! I love it!

I used this right after the exuviance chemical peel and it helped calm the redness. I wish the standard mask shape could get re-worked because I feel like it never fits my face very well and I end up playing with it a lot.

Love this Plumping Mask by Exuviance! It's easy to use and can be easily packed for travel use. I love how it moisturizes my face/ hydrates my skin and reduces puffiness. It only takes 10-15 minutes and it leaves my skin looking smoother and softer feeling. This is a mask I would definitely purchase and use regularly!
I liked this mask! I liked the look of my face afterwards. And my skin felt good. I don't know if I'll be purchasing it anytime soon or not, but I'm thinking about it.
This mask is SO good! I absolutely love the way it makes my face feel immediately after application! Soft, plump, and hydrated! 10/10 recommend!!
Loved the easy to read and easy to follow mask . Has great skin nurturing ingredients, was effective at plumping up my fine lines around my eyes . Had a pleasant scent also . Highly recommend.
Love, love, love this face mask!!! So easy to use, just pull out the sheet and place it on your face. It left my skin feeling super hydrated and soft.

Loved Loved Loved No strong irritating Scent , gives you an automatic glow the second its removed (glow in 15 min) super easy to use if you read the instructions (mask is between 2 mash liners that should be removed). Does everything it claims to do, unlike many MANY other brands, and for someone with Super dry skin, I can legit see the difference immediately!!! Don't walk RUN To get it, especially in this weather that your skin begs for hydration.

I had a great experience trying this mask from Exuviance. After a long day of work, there is nothing better than a moment of self-care and relaxation. The mask is very easy to apply and after 15 minutes I could already see great results on my skin. My skin was very soft, hydrated and refreshing. The mask is made up of hyaluronic acid that provides great benefits to the skin, and also contains coconut water in its formulation, which together work very well on the skin. I noticed that my skin quickly absorbed the product and the result was luminous, smooth and hydrated skin. After 15 minutes I removed the mask and did a gentle massage with my fingers and the sensation was wonderful. I could definitely recommend this brand and their products.

I received this product complimentary for my honest review. The mask is super easy to apply, I was able to do other things while I waited. You can also just relax and let the mask do it's thing too. After using this my skin felt super hydrated and definitely plump. This mask is definitely ok if you have sensitive skin. There is a light fragrance, nothing overwhelming at all. I would definitely purchase this mask again, made my skin feel awesome.

avis.titre: Gives me smooth, luminous, and hydrated skin!
avis.texte: This masks makes my face feel so hydrated and clean! It smells amazing and the hyaluronic acid and caffeine is so effective in it! This brand is absolutely amazing and I'm definitely repurchasing this product. The packaging is super simple and cute!!! I'm obsessed:) This face mask is derived from coconut water which is so good for your skin as well!!!

This Exuviance Pick Me Up Plumping Mask lives up to its name. It felt so good and cool on my face. I like that there is a mesh on both sides so it's easy to apply. You just take one side of the mesh off, place on face, then peel the other mesh off. It has a pleasant light scent and very hydrating. I loved this mask.
Love the look and feel of this hydrating mask. It brightens my face and makes it glassy! Packaging is minimal and contains glycol with a light scent.

Upon application, this mask was very cold but the cooling sensation felt good against my skin. It definitely plumped and hydrated my skin. This is for all skin types, even sensitive skin. And as you can see it's a little bit too big for my face. But unlike other masks, this one stays on perfectly.

I was sent this Pick-Me-Up Plumping Mask free for review and for my honest opinion. This mask was a little too big for me, but all masks are. 🤣 It made my skin feel so hydrated and soft and clean. I wish I was sent more than one mask because I can't say if it actually plumped my skin or not but it was still a fun mask to use.
My skin felt great this week and ready to take on the world! I absolutely love it! Do this at the beginning of the day if you get a few minutes! It is awesome and wakes you up with a light scent

avis.titre: great mask for a Sunday routine!
avis.texte: Loved the plumping mask! Super awesome will br buying again! My skin felt great after the packaging is cute and the ingredients are solid. Used it after a long week of work as my Sunday routine and so glad I did!
This is an awesome product and it really works. It's nice and cooling on the skin and my face feels so soft and clean after I took it off. My skin looks brighter
This mask was very hydrating to my skin and didn't irritate it at all. I have pretty sensitive skin so I was worried but the hyrolonic acid was great for my skin and I would use this again!

avis.titre: One time use at home skincare
avis.texte: Really effective after you remove you massage on face. Left my face soft/smooth like a baby. I liked how it is scent free perfect for face. Like how it's really well packaged and easy to follow instructions.
Love this so much! What a great mask to have on hand for a home hydration last minute type mini facial! I love the caffeine in it for a little extra plump when my skins not feeling fresh.
This mask was amazing. It feels so refreshing while on your skin. The scent is pleasant and not overwhelming. Truly felt results after one use. Definitely makes me want to buy more.

I usually only trust Korean sheet masks but I'll def be adding this one to my staple set! Instantly on initial contact it felt super cool and refreshing. I let it sit for 30 minutes bc I forgot to set a timer but WOW did it leave my skin moisturized

This mask made my skin feel so hydrated!! I love the mask, it fits like a second skin and I felt this was way more effective than many other masks I have tried. It was not super scented and no harsh ingredients. It just felt soothing and hydrating and I will absolutely be buying more!

Love it! Super easy to use! I just put it on my face right after getting out of the shower while I'm doing other things to get ready for the day! The size of the mask is generous, so it covers the entire face and below your chin, too. It's also very gentle, and it has not given me any irritations. This mask is so relaxing. My skin visibly looks smoother help to close pores and reducing fine lines. Love it will purchase again.

The formula is rich and luxurious, with a gentle, soothing texture that leaves my skin feeling pampered. But the real magic happens after just 15 minutes - my skin looks and feels plumper, and a radiant. The mask is easy to apply and remove, and the results last long after the mask is gone. Just wanted to have more than one 😕

I received this complimentary from Influenster for my honest review, These gentle exfoliating pads are great for daily use. They work to slough away dead tissue to improve the appearance of skin. Two thumbs up, highly recommended! .The packaging says m, "gentle daily exfoliating pads" and I would highly agree with that. It is gentle and I love to use it after a shower and it soothes my skin before I apply my other nightly products I really love this brand as they have very high quality skin products that none of their products disappointed me so far

I did not see the instant results that the chemical peel had, but my skin is quite brighter and feels very hydrated. There is no scent with this which is nice. I think I will try it again and see if repetitive use does help any.
PICK Me Up Plumping Mask It's perfect, especially if you have dry skin! My skin is sensitive and I had great results! I've already bought a few more 10/10
I love a good facemask especially because I am almost 40 and have aging skin. I felt like this mask plumped my skin up, helped with my fine lines and wrinkles, and made my make up apply flawlessly.

I love this mask, the box is nice and the packaging is okay, it's easy to use, easy to open, it doesn't have a scent but it feels so good on the skin, it plumps and brightens and leaves my skin so soft and glowing. It has a little bit cooling after you use the peel and it feels so nice.
I am so happy I got to try the Exuviance Pick-Me-Up Plumping Mask. I loved the way my face felt after using this plumping mask. It left my face extra soft and refreshed. I highly recommend.
